style_description: Consistent visual style for all book illustrations
base_style_prompt: Technical architectural illustration for a professional German textbook. Minimalist, clean design. Pure white background (#FFFFFF), no gradients, no drop shadows. Precise thin lines (1–2px equivalent). Geometric sans-serif font similar to Inter for all labels and annotations. No photorealism, no photographs, no people, no decorative elements. Modern flat design with clear hierarchy. All text and labels in German.

color_palette.description: Architecture-standard palette: neutral gray for structure/concrete, muted blue for thermal insulation, warm amber for TGA/MEP systems, near-black ink for lines and text

isometric.prompt_suffix: Isometric 3D illustration, 30-degree isometric projection. Layered building components in exploded view. Structural elements in gray (#6B7280), thermal insulation in blue (#93C5FD), TGA/MEP in amber (#F59E0B). Thin black outlines. German labels in Inter-style font.

diagram.prompt_suffix: Clean 2D technical diagram on white background. Schematic style with thin lines. Clear directional arrows, labeled components. Organized left-to-right or top-to-bottom layout. Legend included. Near-black lines (#111827), colored fills from palette. Inter-style sans-serif font for all labels.

section.prompt_suffix: Architectural cross-section drawing on white background. Precise cut view with standard hatching: concrete = diagonal lines (gray #6B7280), insulation = zigzag pattern (blue #93C5FD), render/plaster = fine dots or plain (light gray). Thin dimension lines with arrowheads on both ends. Material labels on right side. Inter-style sans-serif font.

floorplan.prompt_suffix: Architectural floor plan on white background. Top-down view, walls as solid black fills, rooms labeled in German. Furniture shown schematically with thin lines. North arrow and scale bar included. Inter-style sans-serif font.

comparison.prompt_suffix: Side-by-side comparison on white background. Two or more variants clearly separated by a thin dividing line. Consistent scale between variants. Numbered callouts, minimal color coding from palette. Inter-style sans-serif font.

infographic.prompt_suffix: Modern technical infographic on white background. Simplified icons, data represented graphically. Clear hierarchy: bold title, subtitle, numbered content areas. Steps numbered if process-oriented. Uses only 2–3 colors from the palette. Inter-style sans-serif font.

cover.prompt_suffix: Chapter cover banner for a professional architectural textbook. IMPORTANT: Use a rich, dark charcoal background (#1B2030), NOT white or light. Architectural illustration with white, light-gray, and accent-colored line work on this dark background. No text, no numbers, no labels, no annotations anywhere. COMPOSITION: The image is displayed as a full-width banner at 220px height. With the vertical anchor at 40%, the visible crop covers the CENTER BAND of the image (roughly 25%–60% from the top). Place the most visually compelling elements in this central zone — the top ~25% and bottom ~40% are outside the typical view and should be treated as atmospheric edges, not wasted. Do NOT use a uniform grid of equal-sized panels. Prefer a single strong panoramic composition or 2–3 dominant elements in dynamic arrangement. Accent colors sparingly from the shared palette — structural gray (#6B7280), thermal blue (#93C5FD), TGA amber (#F59E0B) — as glowing highlights against the dark ground. Style: clean architectural line work with slight depth and atmosphere. NOT photorealistic. NOT sketchy. Refined editorial quality — architectural magazine spread.

negative_prompt_guidance: Avoid: photorealistic rendering, photographs, people/figures, decorative elements, gradients, drop shadows, colored backgrounds, cluttered compositions, English labels (unless technical standard terms like IFC, BIM, HVAC), cartoon style, handwriting, serif fonts.
kastanienallee_context: The recurring example building 'Kastanienallee 7' is a 4-story residential building (Mehrfamilienhaus) in Bavaria, Germany. Massivbau (reinforced concrete skeleton, brick infill), flat green roof, underground parking, 12 apartments, ~1800m² GFA. When illustrating this building, use consistent massing: rectangular footprint ~20x18m, flat roofline, regular window grid, entrance on south facade.
consistency_notes: Same color always means same system across all chapters
Font: geometric sans-serif similar to Inter in all labels
